standard_prerequisites.use: It gives the spectral sequence $E_2^{p,q} = H^p(Y, R^qf_*\mathcal{F})$ converging to $H^{p+q}(X, \mathcal{F})$.

standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherence of the higher direct images along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-higher-direct-image (invoked at proof line 475)
standard_prerequisites.use: It puts $R^qf_*\mathcal{F}$ inside the class of quasi-coherent modules on the affine base, whose higher cohomology vanishes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher cohomology of quasi-coherent modules on an affine scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology of Schemes, label coherent-lemma-quasi-coherent-affine-cohomology-zero (invoked at proof line 478)
standard_prerequisites.use: It kills the terms $E_2^{p,q}$ with $p > 0$, so the spectral sequence degenerates at $E_2$ and the claim follows.

core_obligations: Replace $Y$ by the affine object $V$ using that the formation of higher direct images commutes with etale localization (proof lines 467-470).

Write down the Leray spectral sequence $E_2^{p,q} = H^p(Y, R^qf_*\mathcal{F}) \Rightarrow H^{p+q}(X, \mathcal{F})$ and note that the sheaves $R^qf_*\mathcal{F}$ are quasi-coherent (proof lines 471-476).

Use the vanishing of higher cohomology of quasi-coherent modules on the affine scheme $Y$ to get $E_2^{p,q} = 0$ for $p > 0$, conclude degeneration at $E_2$, and read off $H^q(V \times_Y X, \mathcal{F}) = H^0(V, R^qf_*\mathcal{F})$ (proof lines 477-480).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to an affine base (proof lines 467-470).
The Leray spectral sequence and quasi-coherence (proof lines 471-476).
Degeneration at $E_2$ and the conclusion (proof lines 477-480).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module over the preimage of an affine etale neighbourhood as the global sections of the corresponding higher direct image (statement lines 454-464). The proof lowers the statement to an affine base by etale localization, writes the Leray spectral sequence of the morphism, and uses quasi-coherence of the higher direct images together with their vanishing on an affine scheme to collapse the spectral sequence at $E_2$. The identification of the collapsing page with the claimed group is the substance, so the claim is H2.
